profileDescription: Teacher-led, time-bounded sessions for Years 3-6. No student account is required. Classroom routes have no advertising or behavioural tracking; classroom record contents stay in the browser during routine use.

commitments.accounts: No student account, student email, real name, photo or login is required by the classroom build.
commitments.advertising: No advertising is loaded on MetaPet School classroom routes.
commitments.tracking: Classroom routes do not load consumer product analytics or behavioural tracking.
commitments.localRecords: Classroom record contents stay in this browser on this device during routine use.
commitments.supervision: Classroom records belong on a teacher-controlled device or browser profile under normal adult supervision.
commitments.transmission: Routine classroom use does not submit classroom-record contents to B$S. The hosting provider still receives ordinary page requests, and a deliberate teacher export leaves the browser.
commitments.deletion: The supervising adult can delete the covered classroom records immediately from the local-data controls or by clearing this site's browser data.
